task: Resolve print margin collapse and BukSU seal clipping on Secretary Minutes document (OVPAA-F-INS-032), matching authentic 16mm/18mm/20mm margins, seal clearance (>15mm), and editor visual parity established on Action Done Matrix (RU-F-033)

changes.summary: Removed `#root div` from the `@media print` reset block which previously stripped all page margins to 0px via specificity (1, 0, 1). Applied compound high-specificity print selectors (`#root .secretary-minutes-page`, `#root div.secretary-minutes-page`, `.secretary-sheet-paper-container .secretary-minutes-page`) with `padding: 16mm 18mm 20mm 18mm !important`. Pinned official OVPAA-F-INS-032 footer with `left: 18mm; right: 18mm; bottom: 8mm; width: calc(210mm - 36mm) !important`. Updated BuksuDocumentHeader to min-h-[76px] with flex centering and px-20 sm:px-24, ensuring seal clearance exceeds 15mm from physical paper boundaries.
